subject: Re: Kickoff: fairness evaluation module - staffing + July compute
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing: Freya 70% (TL), Umar 40% on causal methodology review, Carmen 50% on the guardrail heuristics, Amara 50% on pipeline engineering - she owns scaling the simulation + bootstrap machinery, since the released run_evaluate.sh is single-node and M3 needs orders of magnitude more runs.

Compute: M1/M2 are cheap - the notebooks and bootstrap runs are CPU-class; a 32-vCPU pool covers it. M3 is the big one: the power study sweeps dataset size x subgroup imbalance x effect size with thousands of bootstrap iterations per cell. For the large-scale power study we hold the vulcan-h100 reservation for the week of 2026-07-06 - 512 accelerators, which I confirmed in the infra tracker last week. Amara should have the simulation sharding ready well before then.

One process note: since this module will gate launch reviews eventually, I want Nadia's PMO looped in at M2, not M3 - fewer surprises later.

Bruno
